hardware: Intel Arc A770 16GB / Xeon E5-2696 v4 / Windows 10
scope: 36 independent GDN layer commits; eager host submission through queue completion. HK16/HV48/C10240, capacity4/6 and all positive accepted counts. Not whole-model throughput.
protocol: Each fresh process: shape-local A/B/A/B/A. Reset+full fingerprint per phase; 3 warmup batches x64 rounds, 9 timed batches x128 rounds; wait at batch end. CPU affinity core4, ABOVE_NORMAL; profiling disabled; exclusive shared root GPU/compiler lock. Adjacent baseline drift<=3%; all shapes positive and capacity equal-weight geometric gain>=1%. Prototype winner and final production helper each get two fresh confirmation processes.

preparation.scope: ACM G10 GDN commit; packed independent chains, unchanged state layout and FP reduction order. Eager submissions.
preparation.rule_before_measurement: Four fixed variants, no resampling. Screen each with shape-local A/B/A/B/A. Confirm the best eligible variant per capacity in two fresh processes. For each capacity4/6, every positive accepted-count shape needs eligible pairs (absolute adjacent baseline drift<=3%), positive pooled throughput gain, and capacity geometric mean gain>=1% in screen and confirmation. Require full bitwise states, CPU history, guards, layer offsets, read-only inputs, dynamic graph, refusal checks. No whole-model speed claim from operator timings.

preparation.scope: ACM G10 GDN commit; 16/32-column cooperative tiles, two/four ESIMD work items. State in registers, two SLM banks for dot partials, one barrier per token. Unchanged FP operation order.
preparation.rule_before_measurement: Two fixed layouts, no resampling. Same shape-local A/B/A/B/A protocol as packed screen. Best eligible variant per capacity needs two fresh confirmation processes. Every positive accepted-count shape needs eligible pairs (absolute adjacent baseline drift<=3%), positive pooled throughput gain, and capacity geometric mean gain>=1% in screen and confirmation. Require 71 full bitwise state/history/guards/offset/input/graph/refusal checks per variant. Eager measurements only; no whole-model speed claim.

preparation.scope: Final production helper, 32 columns/four work items, versus original eight-column/256-GRF baseline. Only host wrapper names differ from production; the original helper supplies the reference.
preparation.rule_before_measurement: Recheck final source with 71 bitwise checks, one shape-local A/B/A/B/A screen and two fresh confirmation processes. No resampling. Every positive accepted-count shape needs eligible pairs (absolute adjacent baseline drift<=3%), positive pooled throughput gain, and capacity geometric mean gain>=1% in screen and confirmation. Eager timings, no whole-model claim.
